say:1:1223608001:1.text: Besides, the roof of our place is leaking again. With the typhoon coming soon, I'm a total basket case now.
say:1:1223608001:1.source_cn: 唉……我们住的那个屋子又漏水了，眼看台风快来了，真愁。
say:1:1223608001:1.male: Besides, the roof of our place is leaking again. With the typhoon coming soon, I'm a total basket case now.
say:1:1223608001:1.female: Besides, the roof of our place is leaking again. With the typhoon coming soon, I'm a total basket case now.

say:2:1223608002:1.text: We can't afford to hire professionals, so I wanted to fix it myself. Yet, I don't even have enough materials...
say:2:1223608002:1.source_cn: 专业的工匠请不起，我想着自己来补，但是原料都凑不齐……
say:2:1223608002:1.male: We can't afford to hire professionals, so I wanted to fix it myself. Yet, I don't even have enough materials...
say:2:1223608002:1.female: We can't afford to hire professionals, so I wanted to fix it myself. Yet, I don't even have enough materials...
